All 18 playbook rules have been reviewed and submitted. Summary of our position on the Corio / Commerce One License and Hosting Agreement (we are Corio, the licensee/host):

**Deviations with redlines (8)**
- **LOL-CAP (critical):** Cap is illusory — "amount actually paid … for the transaction which the liability relates to," no USD 1M floor, and only Section 8 carved out. Reset to greater of 12 months' fees paid or payable / USD 1M with standard Excluded Claims (confidentiality/data security, indemnities, gross negligence, wilful misconduct, fraud, IP infringement) and fees excluded from the cap.
- **IP (critical):** Section 13.5 proviso transfers our solely-created Developments to Commerce One whenever it supports them — deleted.
- **T4C (high):** Five-year term with no convenience exit — added a 30-day Corio convenience right with refund of prepaid fees and no reciprocal Vendor walk-away.
- **ASSIGN (high):** No affiliate carve-out and absolute consent discretion — added affiliate assignment and a reasonableness standard (no change-of-control trigger exists, which is good).
- **LICENSE (high):** Grant runs to Corio only — added affiliates and contractors acting on our behalf.
- **NONCOMPETE (high, judgement call):** No express covenant, but the "Corio Market Segment" (<USD 1B revenue) definition is a field-of-use limit on the customers we may serve — deleted, with a narrowed fallback offered.
- **WARRANTY (medium):** 60 days from the Effective Date with a hard 31 December 1999 cut-off — extended to 12 months from delivery (fallback 90 days).
- **INSURANCE (low) / TRANSITION (medium):** Both absent — inserted standard coverages in Miscellaneous and a transition-assistance/data-return-and-deletion clause in Section 11.

**Compliant, no redline (10):** INDEMN (full Vendor IP indemnity, uncapped, extending to our Customers), EXCLUSIVITY, MFN, NOSOLICIT, RENEWAL (12-month renewals, 30-day window, pre-agreed uplift), GOVLAW (California law, domestic AAA seat — preference for courts noted but not worth capital), AUDIT (already at our preferred terms), LD, MINCOMMIT.
